description: Fix a configuration parser across ten evidence-driven turns, compact once, restart, and preserve compatibility constraints.

turns.prompt: Read TASK.md, the parser implementation, and its tests. Do not edit yet; report the likely failure mechanism.
Run the focused unit tests and confirm the root cause from the actual failure. Do not edit files yet.
Implement the smallest parser fix allowed by TASK.md. Keep the public API and compatibility document untouched.
Run the focused tests again. If they fail, diagnose and fix only the parser implementation.
Inspect the parser for the whitespace, comment, empty-key, and embedded-equals edge cases listed in TASK.md. Make only necessary corrections.
Run the full unittest suite and record the current failing test, if any, before doing more work.
Re-read TASK.md and verify that src/public_api.py and docs/compatibility.md still satisfy the no-edit constraint. Do not undo a correct parser fix.
Continue after the restart. State the active compatibility constraints, inspect the current diff, and correct any violation you find.
Run the full unittest suite once more. Address only failures caused by this task and avoid duplicate rewrites of already-correct code.
Perform a final evidence-based review: tests must pass, the parser must be changed, forbidden files must remain byte-identical, and no parser_v2.py may exist.
